# cty.dat (vendored)

AD1C's amateur radio country file, **Big CTY** edition, from
<https://www.country-files.com/bigcty/cty.dat> — version `VER20260915`
(CTY-3631, 15 September 2026). MIT licence: see `LICENSE` (the copyright
page at <https://www.country-files.com/copyright/>).

Used by the Show Map view to place stations heard without a grid (their
country, continent and centre; `src/js8/callsign_place.cpp` adds regions for
Canada, the US call areas, Australia and Japan) and to find your continent
from your callsign. Desktop JS8Call and WSJT-X ship the same file.

To update: download the new `cty.dat` over this one and change the version
above. The format is described at <https://www.country-files.com/cty-dat-format/>
(longitudes are positive **west**).
